_doc: MCP servers Jarvis loads (core/config.py load_servers). Phase-2 integrations are entries with policy 'integration': they load only when enabled, are read-only unless read_only is false, and every tool not in read_tools is a write that needs Trevor's spoken yes (auto_write: tool -> settings key that lets it run without one). Without a policy, every tool asks unless named in auto_allow. Secrets (OAuth tokens, feed URLs): system keyring via core/secrets.py, never in this file. An entry without a command only shows status (outlook: its calendar is merged into the google server's calendar tools). optional: shown as OPTIONAL rather than NOT CONNECTED. Connect with `jarvis connect <auth>`; see docs/phase2-*.md.

screen.name: screen
screen.note: Window reading + watchers (core/screen.py, core/watch.py). Reads mark the request as having read untrusted screen content, so a later action needs his yes.

control.name: control
control.note: Window control (core/control.py, core/wlinput.py). control_look is a read of screen content; control_run always asks with the whole plan on show, then runs it under a single-use approval the gate writes. Kill switch: Super+Shift+Escape or "stop" (jarvis control stop).

google.name: Google
google.label: GMAIL · CALENDAR · DRIVE
google.note: Writes: calendar_create_event / calendar_update_event / calendar_delete_event, his main calendar only, every one with his yes (no auto_write; core/brain.ALWAYS_ASK), logged with `jarvis calendar undo`. Mail and Drive stay read-only: there are no tools for them.

outlook.name: Outlook
outlook.label: UWATERLOO CALENDAR · MAIL
outlook.note: UW blocks the Graph app route. The calendar comes from Outlook's published ICS link (keyring jarvis:outlook / ical_url, mcp/outlook_ical.py), merged into calendar_today / calendar_next; UW mail forwards into Gmail and is read by the google tools.

academic.name: LEARN
academic.label: ASSIGNMENTS · GRADES
academic.note: Writes: tracker_update / tracker_add (his SE tracker sheet only, always with his yes) and, while no tracker is set up, the dedicated 'STARK – Assignments' calendar (jarvisAssignmentsAccount picks Google or Outlook).

microsoft.name: Microsoft 365 (direct)
microsoft.label: DIRECT CONNECTION · NEEDS ADMIN CONSENT
microsoft.note: Optional Graph route; UWaterloo blocks user consent, so Outlook normally comes in through the outlook entry (calendar link + mail forwarding).
